description: A dashboard to expose libvirt Metrics and Project Overview

panels.title: VMs by memory used %
panels.description: Guest memory in use as a share of the VM's memory: 1 - usable / maximum, where usable is the guest's MemAvailable from the balloon driver. VMs without balloon stats are not listed.

panels.title: RX/TX Packets Per Sec on VMs

targets.expr: topk(10, rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(domain) group_left(flavor,instance_name,project_name,user_name) (libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"} or libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"})) or on() vector(0)

topk(10, rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(domain) group_left(flavor,instance_name,project_name,user_name) (libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"} or libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"})) or on() vector(0)

panels.description: Average time per write request as the guest sees it (libvirt), per disk.

targets.expr:
topk(20,
  rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_time_seconds_total{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval])
  / rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval])
  * on(domain) group_left(instance_name) max by (domain, instance_name) (libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"})
)

panels.title: Write latency

panels.description: Average time per read request as the guest sees it (libvirt), per disk.

targets.expr:
topk(20,
  rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_time_seconds_total{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval])
  / rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_requests_total{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval])
  * on(domain) group_left(instance_name) max by (domain, instance_name) (libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"})
)
